title: Gyárak, gőzmalmok és vasutak (Mills, Iron & Rails)
grammar: Dual State Structures, Commemorative Postpositions & Urban Innovation Verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say why Budapest's milling and engineering industries were famous.
I can use the superlative and világviszonylatban to describe an achievement.
I can name the Ganz works, the railway network and river regulation in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about industry and railways and answer questions about it.
